purpose: Teach: ジョナサン/ジャカルタ/草津/マイアミ/ロースト/ニーチェ/のび太/ワトソン

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがジョナサンの物語を朗読して下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad's going to read you the Jonathan story.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact announcement. Slight lift of anticipation in her voice—she knows he'll enjoy this. Confident, gentle maternal cadence.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとジャカルタの絵本読んだよ
lines.en: Mom, I looked at a picture book about Jakarta with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, eager rush of words tumbling out. Small voice building with pride at the memory. Quick, genuine excitement—not performed for approval, just sharing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが草津温泉のお湯がお好きなのよ
lines.en: Sho, your father really loves the hot springs at Kusatsu.
lines.style: Gentle observation, almost musing. Soft, knowing tone—she's sharing something tender about his father. Warm pause before the thought settles.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとマイアミの絵見たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I saw a picture of Miami together!
lines.style: Insistent, bright. Building on his earlier news. Same eager rhythm, same genuine spark. Wants to keep sharing, keep being heard.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがローストビーフのご馳走を作って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father made a lovely roast beef dinner for us.
lines.style: Warm recollection with quiet pride. Speaks with the satisfaction of something already given, not promised. Tender undertone—she's noticing his father's care.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとニーチェの絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mom, I looked at a Nietzsche picture book with Dad!
lines.style: Same bright insistence as before, but with a touch more confidence now. Rapid-fire, wanting her attention on this. Small laugh threaded through—delight at the strangeness of the pairing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがのび太の漫画を貸して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father lent you that Nobita manga.
lines.style: Quiet confirmation, almost wistful. She's noticing what he's noticing—the accumulation of small father-son moments. Gentle, reflective delivery. Slight trailing softness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとシャーロック・ホームズのワトソンの話したよ
lines.en: Mom, I talked to Dad about Watson from Sherlock Holmes!
lines.style: Final bright surge of excitement, words pressing forward. Breathless quality—he's been waiting to say this. Peak of his energy. Small, satisfied close.
